youtube.title: One ad, four screen shapes: 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 and 4:5 from one shot list
youtube.description:
One ad. Four screen shapes.
The GLOWMOP demo ad (a fictional brand) rendered by funkbox in 9:16, 16:9, 1:1 and 4:5. The only change to its shot list: one added line, "formats". Same cuts, same captions. This 20 s Short rendered in 39 seconds on a 4-core CPU with no GPU.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
Made with funkbox.
